description: This file defines the 'mantisdbInterface' class which extends 'issueTrackerInterface' and manages interactions with a Mantis Bug Tracker database, including retrieving issue data, constructing issue URLs, and handling bug statuses.

classes.name: mantisdbInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with Mantis Bug Tracker database for retrieving and managing bug issues.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, connects to the database, and sets default statuses and configurations.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL to view a specific bug in Mantis based on bug ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches issue details from the Mantis database given an issue ID.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of a bug given its ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the specified ID exists in the database.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Validates the syntax of a bug ID.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Creates an HTML-formatted string representing the bug status with optional decoration.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default XML template for configuring the Mantis database connection and statuses.

methods.name: setStatusCfg
methods.description: Configures status codes and corresponding colors based on the loaded configuration.

methods.name: getCodeStatus
methods.description: Returns the array mapping status codes to their verbose descriptions.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns the array mapping status descriptions to their associated colors.
